purpose: Research questionnaire; not a CLI schema, execution policy, or planner instruction.

questions.question: What exact bytes are we examining, and where did they come from?
questions.evidence_to_retain: SHA-256, size, acquisition source/time, report reference; distinguish archive and extracted-child hashes

questions.question: What format, architecture, OS/runtime, and entry points can we establish?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Header evidence and tool output; explicitly record unsupported architectures

questions.question: Is this executable code, a container, an installer, a library, or a data file?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Classification evidence and relevant child artifacts

questions.question: Are packing, compression, encryption, or compiler/runtime conventions limiting analysis?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Identification results, tool warnings, sections, entropy as a clue rather than proof

questions.question: Have we already analyzed these exact bytes?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Existing sample/run IDs; identical hashes only, not a similarity inference

questions.question: Which three places are worth inspecting first, and why?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Addresses with address type, source tool, evidence references; record a thin result honestly

questions.question: Which external inputs does the program consume?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Relevant callers and data flow for arguments, files, messages, or environment values

questions.question: Where does configuration come from, and which code consumes it?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Configuration location/format, parsing code, consumers; preserve original bytes

questions.question: Which files or directories does it read, create, change, or delete?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Code references and operation context; distinguish static possibilities from observed operations

questions.question: Does it communicate over a network, and what code controls that communication?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Callers, protocol evidence, configuration sources; strings alone are insufficient

questions.question: Does it launch other programs or load additional modules?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Relevant caller and arguments where recoverable; unresolved arguments remain unknown

questions.question: Does it arrange to run again after restart or login?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Relevant startup-setting changes and supporting code; a registry or path string alone is a lead

questions.question: Does it collect sensitive information, and what supports that interpretation?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Accessing code, data categories, subsequent use; avoid copying actual secrets into reports

questions.question: What transformations does it apply to data?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Relevant compression, encoding, cryptographic, or parsing routines with supporting observations

questions.question: What conditions select different behavior?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Configuration flags, platform checks, error paths, or input-dependent branches

questions.question: What externally visible artifacts could a defender check for?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Supported paths, configuration characteristics, or other observables, with scope and limitations

questions.question: If a runtime observation is available, does it agree with the static interpretation?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Trace/run identity and conditions; otherwise mark not assessed—this question authorizes no execution

questions.question: Which claims from the source report are supported by our own evidence?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Claim IDs, source quotation/reference, independent supporting evidence, contradictions

questions.question: If a comparison sample is supplied, what changed that matters to this question?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Both hashes, matched scope, changed evidence; distinguish rebuild noise from explained behavior changes

questions.question: What plausible ordinary functionality explains an apparently suspicious lead?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Alternative interpretation and supporting evidence, including benign controls where appropriate

questions.question: What ran, what was skipped or failed, and what remains outside coverage?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Adapter statuses, versions, rule revisions, limits, timeouts, unsupported features

questions.question: Which conclusions are observations, which are interpretations, and which remain unsupported?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Claim-level evidence links and limitations; no probability inferred from ranking points

questions.question: What single follow-up inspection would most reduce the remaining uncertainty?
questions.evidence_to_retain: A bounded analyst-selected question and required evidence; no automatic command execution

questions.question: Can another analyst reproduce the result and resume without repeating the same work?
questions.evidence_to_retain: Run manifest, tool outputs, trajectory, project reference, question answers, unresolved items
